### Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and before/after behavior. Identify the source base, affected entry point and workflow mode.

### Scope and boundaries

List the owned paths and any interface or approval changes. Explain local/cloud context effects, compatibility and recovery implications when relevant. Identify any separate integration dependency.

### Verification

Provide the exact commands, runtime/platform, exit results and a short bounded evidence summary. Distinguish fake/loopback fixtures, native checks, disposable installed proof, actual coding apps and real model tasks. Name any checks not run and their required inputs. A passing fixture does not qualify a public download or live host/model.

### Remaining limitations

State unresolved findings and retained/uncertain ownership. Do not weaken checks, clear holds or discard failure evidence to obtain a pass.

- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private endpoints/paths, task contents or raw databases.
- [ ] Claims match the actual checks and evidence level.
- [ ] Execution, provider spending and mode changes stay within explicit authorization.

Do not submit vulnerability details through this public template. See the security policy (`SECURITY.md` in this checkout) for the unresolved private reporting channel.
